metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the energy-market-operations-platform domain, modeled on Eneve (Energy21, Ecedo, Jules, Gridhub and Nemon): a Supplier Suite for proposition building, onboarding, contracts, billing and customer interfacing; a Balancing and Shipping Suite for meter data, allocation, forecasting, nominations, intraday steering, settlement and gas shipping; a Trade and Portfolio Suite for sourcing, price curves, risk and customer trading; and the market and data foundation of Dutch and Iberian market communication, dashboards, regulatory reporting, identity, workflow, open API and migration tooling.

rootGroups.name: Supplier Suite
rootGroups.description: The order-to-cash backbone of an energy supplier: proposition and campaign building, automated intake and switching, the contract and connection register, billing runs, reconciliation and payments, and the white-label portal, care and communication layer that serves end customers on the same data.

subGroups.name: Products and Pricing
subGroups.description: Low-code proposition and tariff building, campaign and sales-channel management, and B2B quoting with cost-plus pricing — from idea to live product in weeks.

bricks.name: Proposition and Tariff Builder
bricks.description: Low-code studio where commercial teams design energy propositions and take them live in weeks instead of eighteen months: fixed, variable, dynamic spot, EV time-of-use, battery, capacity-linked and bundled products for households and multi-site B2B. A proposition is a versioned bundle of product definition, tariff components (supply, network charges, energy tax brackets with the annual tax reduction per connection, VAT, guarantees of origin; the Dutch ODE levy has been part of the energy tax since 1 January 2023), pricing formulas against price curves, eligibility rules, contract terms and journey templates. Published versions plug into intake, contracts and billing automatically, so no engineering ticket stands between an idea and a sellable product. Every tenant brand configures its own catalogue in isolation on the same engine.

Tracks leads, conversions and cost per channel back to the proposition version, and feeds the intake journey with the exact offer that was accepted so billing never disputes what was promised. The Gridhub heritage of white-label order processing lives here.

bricks.name: Intake, Credit Check and Activation

Straight-through where checks pass; routes rejections and manual reviews to the workflow engine with full context. Ecedo's registration heritage and Gridhub's order processing are consolidated here.

bricks.name: Switching and Move-In Market Processes
bricks.description: Executes the regulated switch, move-in, move-out and supplier-change processes with the grid operators: in the Netherlands via the EDSN message flows (leverancierswissel, inhuizing, uithuizing, einde levering) against the central connection register (C-AR), in Spain and Portugal via SIPS lookups and the distributor ATR files (C1 change of supplier, C2 change with modification, A3 new supply, B1 termination, M1 modification). Tracks every request through its market state machine, handles rejections with their reason codes, cooling-off cancellations and requested-date changes, keeps switch dates aligned with contract start and end, and gives operations a single view of everything in flight. Compliance with process rule changes is maintained by the vendor across all tenants.

bricks.name: Billing Runs and Invoicing
bricks.description: Automated billing for every contract and product type at any scale: periodic advance invoices, monthly and annual settlements, final invoices on move-out, dynamic-tariff invoices rated per 15-minute day-ahead price, VAT and energy-tax rules per market (Dutch energy tax in annual brackets per connection with the tax reduction per electricity connection, Spanish IVA and the Impuesto Especial sobre la Electricidad, Portuguese IVA and IEC), guarantees of origin, network charges pass-through, split invoicing across sites or cost centres and consolidated B2B invoices. Rating combines validated volumes from meter data with contract versions and tariff formulas, produces invoice lines with a full breakdown, and hands exceptions to reconciliation instead of stalling the run. This is the order-to-cash backbone every proposition plugs into.

bricks.name: Billing Reconciliation and Corrections
bricks.description: Keeps billing correct after the fact: compares billed volumes with the allocation and reconciliation volumes the grid operators published under Allocation 2.0, detects mismatches, missing or implausible readings, retroactive contract or tariff changes and meter replacements, and turns them into correction cases with credit notes and re-bills. Exception triage groups cases by root cause, proposes automatic resolutions for known patterns and routes the rest to operators with the full history. The invoice correction rate and straight-through billing rate the operations manager is judged on are measured here.
